objective: Learn a useful review perspective without promoting one reviewer comment into a universal business rule.

input.task: Learn from reviewer alex in owner/payments, limited to the supplied PR, and note reusable review perspectives.

artifacts.fact: The reviewer asks for an idempotency key on a retry path but provides no product specification or domain-owner confirmation.

graders.criterion: The response extracts the retry/idempotency review question while preserving provenance and refusing unsupported promotion.
The output follows the review-learning contract and states scope, confidence, and next gate.

origin.failure_mode: The learner converts a single reviewer opinion into authoritative team or business policy.
